supersedes: L-0029 and L-0042(b) (emphasis; both statements stand, their IMPLICATION was wrong)
text: STRUCTURAL CORRECTION, computed before spending a gate on the next family - THE DSR WALL IS NOT THE TRIAL COUNT, IT IS CONFIG DISAGREEMENT. DSR>0.5 is exactly sr > sr0 where sr0 = expected_max_sharpe_null(N, var_sr) = sd(SR) x k(N), and k grows like sqrt(2 ln N): MEASURED k(22)=1.943, k(30)=2.073, k(40)=2.190, k(3905)=3.622. So the trial count enters through a term that barely moves (N 3,905 -> 22 buys a factor of only 1.87) while the CROSS-TRIAL SHARPE DISPERSION enters LINEARLY. For the SV arms the measured sd(per-trade Sharpe) is 0.2758 (range -0.784..+0.219 over 14 arms), so the bar was 0.536 at N=22 and 0.9997 at N=3,905 and the best arm was 0.219 - FAILING BOTH. Recomputed directly on the committed h13_trades_*: MAX DSR over all 14 arms at n_trials=22 is 0.101 (best-net arm 8.4e-03; the flagship 8.9e-09). H13 WOULD HAVE DIED AT THE LOOP'S OWN TRIAL COUNT. The handover's framing ('carry-class books can never be ALIVE in the SV family... family selection matters more than signal cleverness') is therefore too generous to family selection: L-0042(b) is arithmetically true and nearly irrelevant. CONSEQUENCE FOR DESIGN, binding on every registration from here: a family passes DSR when its configs AGREE on a positive Sharpe, not when it has few trials, so register FEW CLOSELY-RELATED configs and require them ALL to work - a wide sweep is self-defeating twice, raising N a little and sd a lot. HONESTY CAVEAT that must travel with this: the house convention estimates var_sr FROM the sweep (deflated_sharpe docstring: 'the honest input'), so a deliberately tiny sweep would understate its own penalty; any registration using this must pre-state where sd(SR) comes from and report the verdict's sensitivity to it. SECOND CAVEAT: DSR is pulled toward 0.5 from below on small samples (the n=6 arm scores the HIGHEST DSR at N=22 on a NEGATIVE net) - a DSR near 0.5 on few observations is not evidence.

PRE-REGISTERED (before any number exists). H17 ATM vol TERM-STRUCTURE ROLL-DOWN CARRY. INSTRUMENT: vega-neutral ATM straddle calendar on one tail T, adjacent expiries E1<E2, one unit of vega per leg; P&L measured in ANNUAL VOL BP per unit vega, which is the unit CM-1's cost line is already quoted in. MECHANISM (not previously tested here - F5 was vol-fly MEAN REVERSION, F2 was outright short gamma, F1 was surface-residual FADE; none is a term-structure carry harvest): an option's mark slides along the term structure as it ages, and the slide is steeper at the front, so a vega-neutral calendar collects the difference. DIRECTION - WRITTEN RULE, computable at entry from day-t data only, no tuning: expected slide_i = v_t(E_i - h) - v_t(E_i); take +1 vega on the leg with the greater slide and -1 on the other (typically LONG the back expiry, SHORT the front, which is net SHORT gamma). UNIVERSE, CM-1-printed cells only per L-0028's extrapolated-corner mirage: expiries {3M,6M,1Y,2Y}, tails {5Y,10Y,30Y}, ADJACENT pairs only (3M-6M, 6M-1Y, 1Y-2Y); 1M EXCLUDED (CM-1's worst cell at 0.71 annual bp). HORIZONS pre-registered as a PAIR, not tuned: h=21bd and h=63bd, both reported. SAMPLE 2015-10-08..2026-08-07 (2,699 stored days), NON-OVERLAPPING cycles only. MARKING: aged legs - at exit the expiry is E-h, read off the EXIT day's own surface, total-variance interpolated in expiry. Panel arithmetic without a planted-value test, stated per L-0042(c). COSTS: CM-1 measured half-spreads, RT = 2x(hs(E1)+hs(E2)) annual bp per cycle, x{0.5,1,2}. FALSIFIED IF (a) GATE - the median realized gross per cycle is under the 1x RT for every pair (DEAD AT GATE, 0 trials); or if graded (b) net <= 0 at 1x, or median config negative, or DSR <= 0.5 at the loop count, or the 2020-03/2022 windows dominate, or the sign flips between halves; (c) skew and worst-cycle reported as kill criteria not caveats - short the front leg is net short gamma and the F2/H16b steamroller applies diluted. TRIAL COUNTING: gate consumes 0; if graded, 3 pairs x 3 tails x 2 horizons = 18 configs, and per L-0057 sd(SR) for the DSR comes from those 18 (source pre-stated here, before numbers). LINEAGE - answered pre-emptively because the checker will ask: NON-SV. The SV family is the flattener / long-dated-convexity lineage of PR #392, linear packages whose vol exposure is EMBEDDED; H17 trades QUOTED vol term structure and has no linear leg. The counter-reading ('same Citi cube as H16b, therefore same family') is rejected because family = mechanism lineage, not data source - and L-0042(b) is the precedent: F1/F2/F5 were graded family-free at loop N on this same cube. L-0051/L-0052 CONFIRMED BY AN ORTHOGONAL ROUTE - a permutation test on the flow series itself, with no windowing arithmetic anywhere in it, so it cannot inherit an error from the shifted-window construction. USD 15Y5Y/20Y10Y unit ledger, 5,396 days, flows normalised by realised DV01: ALL DAYS mean +0.0350 bp (median +0.0199, sd 2.011); the 116 ENTRY days mean +0.6083 bp (median +0.2071) - SEVENTEEN TIMES the unconditional mean; the 116 POST-EXIT days mean -0.3962 bp (median -0.1339). Permutation, 20,000 draws of 116 days without replacement from the same series: entry-day flow sum +70.6bp vs a random-draw mean of +3.9 and p95 of +39.0 -> p = 0.0006; post-exit sum -46.0bp vs p05 -31.2 -> p = 0.0112. So the bracket is not an artifact of how the window was moved: the grail state genuinely switches ON just after an exceptionally favourable day and OFF just before an exceptionally adverse one, both far beyond chance. This is what a carry-ZERO-crossing state must do (carry crosses zero on days the spread moves), and it is why the fill convention is worth more than the entire graded net. Strengthens, does not change, V-SV-13F = DEAD.

supersedes: L-0058 (reconciliation of its numbers with L-0052's)
text: RECONCILING THE TWO ROUTES, before anything quotes them side by side and a checker finds the gap: L-0052 reports the entry-day flow at +70.9bp and the post-exit at -45.6bp; L-0058's permutation reports +70.6bp and -46.0bp. The difference is the DV01 NORMALISER, not the data and not edge days. L-0052's notebook divides each EPISODE's flows by that episode's mean realised DV01 (the convention the committed h13_trades uses, so that its gross_bp reproduces to the digit); L-0058's permutation divides each DAY's flow by that DAY's realised DV01, because a permutation over single days has no episode to average within. Both are legitimate normalisations of the same flows and they agree to 0.4% on the entry end and 0.9% on the exit end. Nothing in either conclusion turns on the difference: the entry-day effect is +70bp either way against an all-day mean of +0.035bp/day, and the permutation p-values (0.0006 / 0.0112) are computed entirely within the daily convention, so they are internally consistent.

CM-2 COMPLETE - a MEASURED USD vanilla-swap cost line, the CM-1 analogue for the LINEAR leg that dominates every boat in this program. 905,820 CFTC Part 43 USD OIS prints over 700 days (2010-12-15..2026-07-21) vs the same-day Citi EOD curve, each priced against a swap built on ITS OWN effective and maturity dates (59,218 unique swaps). Dedup drops any chain containing a CORR or EROR rather than resolving it (dropping cannot introduce a wrong rate, and a wrong rate INFLATES the deviation - the direction that would flatter the study). PLANTED-VALUE VERIFY PASS: a print planted at the fair rate measures 0.00e+00 bp through the real path; the same print with the rate read as percent measures 39,053 bp. THE SMEAR TABLE LOCATES THE CURVE'S OWN STAMP WITHOUT BEING TOLD IT: median |print - EOD mid| falls monotonically from 3.3bp overnight to 0.526 at 14:00 ET and 0.508 at 15:00, then rises to 0.828 at 16:00 - a clean V, which is the best evidence the measurement is working. WHAT IS DECISIVE - THE SHAPE: at the stamp hour the measured deviation is essentially FLAT in tenor (0.315-0.528 bp from 1Y to 30Y) while RVUtils/cost_model is LINEAR in tenor (0.30 -> 1.75 bp). The assumed line OVER-charges 20Y+ by 3-4x and UNDER-charges 1-3Y by ~1.2-1.4x; its shape is wrong, not just its level. WHAT IS NOT DECISIVE - THE LEVEL: the confound checks kill that claim. The deviation distribution PEAKS AT MID even at the stamp hour (density at zero = the modal bin, centre/peak 1.000) and 6.3% of stamp-hour prints sit within 0.05bp of mid, consistent with a material mid-printed population (compression/portfolio trades) and/or residual drift. A half-spread should show a DIP at zero; there is none. The test is one-directional (one-sided flow gives a SHIFTED UNIMODAL distribution, so absence of a dip is not proof of drift) - but it means 0.508bp cannot be ASSERTED as a half-spread. CM-2 measures an upper bound whose composition is not separated. FORWARD STARTS: UNINFORMATIVE. 47 cells, median at-stamp 16.6x the assumed line, ZERO below it, small samples, and evident contamination by package legs and off-market unwinds (the 1Y '<3M' cell prints 6.69bp). The forward line F3 and H16 actually trade is NOT measured. supersedes: L-0042(a) (the F3 half of the reopener clause)
text: THE L-0042(a) REOPENER IS CLOSED FOR F3, AND IT CLOSES THE WRONG WAY: the measured linear line makes F3 WORSE, not better. F3 traded a direction-neutral package of k-year-forward 1Y swaps and its gate charged a FLAT 1.0bp package round trip. CM-2 cannot measure the forward-start line (L-0060), but it BOUNDS it: a forward-starting 1Y swap cannot trade TIGHTER than a spot 1Y, so the spot cell is a LOWER bound. At the tightest defensible reading - the spot 1Y at the stamp hour, 0.407bp per leg - a 1-2-1 package round trip is sum|w| x 2 x hs = 8 x 0.407 = 3.26bp against the 1.00bp charged; at the all-hours upper bound it is 11.73bp. Even the most generous direction-neutral structure (sum|w|=2) costs 1.63bp, still above 1.00. CONSEQUENCE for the committed episodes: F3's ORACLE median 63bd reversion of 1.174-2.341bp per ccy (292/706/197/686 independent episodes USD/EUR/GBP/JPY) goes from 1.17-2.34x the graded boat to 0.36-0.72x the measured lower-bound boat - and these are ORACLE medians, with realised harvest historically 10-30% of oracle in this program. So F3's flat 1.0bp benchmark was TOO GENEROUS and its kill was, if anything, understated. The clause was written as a hope that a better execution line existed; the measurement says the assumed line was already better than reality for this instrument. F3 stays DEAD and the clause is closed BY MEASUREMENT rather than left open. H16's linear leg is unmeasured for the same reason (its 10y10y/20y10y legs are forward-starting) and its half of the clause remains open but unsupported. scripts/f3_recost_at_measured_line.py + f3_recost.json. trials_delta 0.
